title: The Brain, Body, and Behaviour Dataset (1.0.0) - Experiment 1
description: Eye-tracking data from 27 participants who watched five educational videos under two attention conditions. In the attentive session, participants expected a test and answered factual multiple-choice questions after each video. In the distracted session, participants silently counted backwards in steps of 7 and were not tested. The dataset includes gaze, pupil size, blinks, saccades and fixations, and is Experiment 1 of the Brain, Body, and Behavior Dataset (BBBD).
methods_description: Participants watched five informative YouTube videos in random order while gaze position and pupil size were recorded with an eye tracker. Session 1 was the attentive condition, with 11-12 factual multiple-choice memory questions after each video, plus domain-knowledge questions before each video. Session 2 was the distracted condition, in which participants silently counted backwards from a random prime number in steps of 7 and answered no questions. The dataset is BIDS-formatted and includes derivatives such as blink, saccade and fixation timestamps and rates.
